accessibility_and_international_text.desktop_controls: Shared assets publish roles, names, descriptions, values, logical reading/focus order, disabled reasons and all actions to the live AccessKit tree. Keyboard navigation, focus visibility, non-color status, discoverable labels, zoom/high-DPI, large pointer/pen targets and gesture cancellation are part of the same asset, not per-panel patches.
accessibility_and_international_text.composition: Preserve active spec unified international typography: complex-script shaping, RTL/bidi, grapheme/IME boundaries, Arabic/Hebrew marks and kashida, CJK kinsoku/mojikumi, vertical type and mixed Latin/CJK runs. UI text-entry controls consume existing text/selection/focus owners; design-document text uses the shared typography engine. Bundled font presence alone does not prove shaping fidelity.
accessibility_and_international_text.verification: Compare glyph positioning, caret movement, selection, IME composition, line breaks, vertical runs, font fallback and multi-column reflow against controlled reference artifacts. UI strings may localize; object IDs, enum tokens, command IDs and manual anchors do not. No separate world-ready build or English-only parity claim.
accessibility_and_international_text.publication: Accessible app UI and accessible exported PDF/EPUB are separate outcomes; require semantic tag/reading-order proof in addition to pixels.

figma_native_conversion.stance: Opening user-provided .fig and converting into native StudioDocument is a fixture-proven compatibility target, not established capability. Preserve original bytes/digest and source-qualified IDs under current resource grants and operator retention policy; retained bytes must not leak into sanitized output. Keep a typed conversion manifest naming imported, remapped, unsupported, flattened and missing objects/properties. Do not replace the requested .fig importer with SVG/PNG/token import and call it equivalent.
figma_native_conversion.current_limitations: Official local-copy documentation says .fig is proprietary and may change, excludes version history/comments, and reimport creates new component identities disconnected from originals. The offline documentation additionally warns that unloaded pages may be absent. Studio cannot recover absent source history/pages by pretending conversion preserved them.
figma_native_conversion.implementation_boundary: A parser/adapter requires versioned real fixtures, resource/font/image resolution, component/variant/variable/auto-layout/prototype mapping and source-to-native relation records. Unknown records are retained opaquely where possible with explicit unsupported findings; partial import must remain reviewable. Optional authorized export/API bridges may enrich a source but cannot become required online operation.
figma_native_conversion.proof: Open real .fig fixtures with nested/remote components, aliases/modes, mixed text, auto-layout and prototypes; reconcile source object/property counts and relationships; compare native render and editing behavior with exact source reference. Reopen saved native package and verify editable relationships. Preserve prior per-format export/round-trip obligations; report .fig import+conversion separately and never infer .fig export support from a successful import.

desktop_information_architecture.decision: Preserve one Studio workspace, one document authority and many independent document/view/panel instances. No suite-product app selector, hosted dashboard, pricing page or browser-first shell.
desktop_information_architecture.layout: Existing specified Context Bar + Tool Rail + Browse Dock + Inspect Dock + Meter Rail + Time & Results Dock around the centre document view tree. Consume canonical dock/split/tab/popup/focus owners. Distinct clip timeline and keyframe timeline share time/navigation/selection mechanics and are tabbed or side-by-side views of one document.
desktop_information_architecture.workflow_contexts: Raster, vector, layout, raw/catalogue, prototype, sequence and composition capabilities follow document profile and selection. Layout Presets only rearrange UI prominence. Task Scope explicitly enters/exits a temporary tool-plus-options workflow without turning it into a separate app.
desktop_information_architecture.discoverability: One availability evaluation across menu, palette, rail and inspectors. Search retains unavailable capabilities with reason and remedy. Show whether a field changes the next tool action (Tool Zone) or existing selected objects (Selection Zone/Properties). Display units, mixed multi-selection values, active container/time, dirty/history and background job state.
desktop_information_architecture.density: Professional compact desktop layout with keyboard, mouse, pen and touch routes. Preserve existing spec minimum hit targets and splitter arbitration; DPI and touch affordances enlarge hit regions without erasing expert controls. Avoid card grids with large empty margins replacing tool density.
desktop_information_architecture.multi_view: One document can have side-by-side source/program, spread, canvas, curve, timeline and compare views. Each view owns zoom/pan/rotation/visible overlays/selection presentation; document content, history, time model and resource IDs remain shared. Agent view contexts are independent from the Operator's focused view by default.

argus_and_parallel_contract.stance: Shipped product operation and development proof use the same controls/command semantics. Argus is not a testing-only facade. Canonical four-method protocol remains the transport for GUI control/observation; rich edits use typed Studio commands rather than OS injection.
inspection_additions: Selection set and actor-owned view context
Numeric/enum/property/TemporalState metadata required by current spec
Canonical total versus UI slice with explicit continuation
Render/capture identity linked to mutation receipt
capture_additions: source asset hash and proxy/original identity
capture source live_window or offscreen; deferred/failed/stale classification
argus_and_parallel_contract.visual_outcome_gate: Read canonical state before command; simulate typed change; execute through same authority path as UI; wait for causal completion/render receipt; inspect fresh state; obtain matched real pixels; open and compare that exact capture against expected outcome. Structural AccessKit proof alone cannot establish compositing, mask edges, glyph correctness, color or frame content. Screenshot alone cannot establish print/colorimetric correctness or encoded-media output fidelity.
argus_and_parallel_contract.canvas_operations: Typed paths, masks, brush sample streams, transforms, selections and timeline operations target persistent domain IDs with document revision and declared coordinate/time space. Expose equivalent control/preview/commit targets and observable semantic overlays. Arbitrary screen coordinates or an unsupported fifth Argus method are not assumed to exist.
argus_and_parallel_contract.parallelism: One Operator focus context remains stable. Agent sessions own explicit independent view/selection contexts, can request reveal without moving the Operator view, and work on proposals/branches or CRDT-disjoint regions. Existing file-scoped promotion/lease/idempotency law remains canonical; UI widget leases supplement it and never replace it. Ordered promotion rejects stale base revisions/conflicts. Leases expire, jobs cancel/resume, retries are idempotent and presence is observable without stealing focus.
argus_and_parallel_contract.attribution_reconciliation: WP012 wire actually implements client_session_id, while HBR/Studio prose says agent_label. Resolve exact supported name in approved contract before publishing manual/examples; an alias needs explicit implementation/proof. Neither attribution label is a security identity; authenticated account/actor authorization remains separate.
argus_and_parallel_contract.standalone_asset_boundary: Engineering cross-review: standalone assets consume neutral exported descriptor contracts and an immutable generated descriptor/manual snapshot, with in-memory fixture view/layout state. They do not import handshake_native/core or connect to SurrealDB merely to render controls. Snapshot code/source/schema/version digests and a visibly declared fixture authority keep evidence honest. Only a later host adapter binds canonical AppCommand/UiDescriptor, persisted UserManual/layout and runtime resource grants. The snapshot is generated reference content, never a second editable shipped registry.
argus_and_parallel_contract.private_resource_boundary: Argus inspect, click, set_value, capture, jobs and descriptor-backed previews all enforce the authenticated actor's current document/resource grants. IDs, view or session labels and serialized manifest grants never grant access. Evaluate every graph, linked asset, original source attachment, preview and capture, including stale caches, after grant revocation. Private document labels/property values and render pixels must not leak through another agent's view or shared diagnostic ring. Reveal and screenshot requests are explicitly scoped to an authorized independent view; multiple view contexts cannot widen observation authority.

deliberated_decisions.rejected: Single Studio crate or standalone harness that imports the full Handshake shell/backend.
deliberated_decisions.proof: Package/dependency graph and warm affected-package build proof supplied by engineering plan; later adapter consumes contracts without a cycle.

deliberated_decisions.decision: Clip timeline and keyframe timeline share mechanics/time but retain different semantics
deliberated_decisions.reason: Active STU-VID-022 and media-team deliberation distinguish clip source windows from property value streams.
deliberated_decisions.rejected: One universal timeline type that cannot represent source/program time, independent keyframe tangents or audio automation.
deliberated_decisions.proof: Same playhead maps to both views and renderer; typed domain IDs/rational time preserved.

deliberated_decisions.decision: Typed domain commands plus Argus visual verification
deliberated_decisions.reason: Current four Argus methods and command-first spec already define the boundary. Complex strokes/paths/trims require typed engine operations, not coordinate scraping.
deliberated_decisions.rejected: OS mouse/keyboard injection or a hidden test-only API that users' agents cannot access.
deliberated_decisions.proof: Shipped command discovery/control paths and actual post-action pixels share document revision and causal receipt.

deliberated_decisions.decision: Preserve current egui/egui_tiles asset ownership and study upgrades separately
deliberated_decisions.reason: Current project uses egui 0.33/egui_tiles 0.14; newer upstream fixes identity/a11y but raises MSRV. No framework rewrite is justified by this research.
deliberated_decisions.rejected: Fresh webview/Electron/SaaS shell or blind latest-version bump.
deliberated_decisions.proof: Version-specific dock identity/accessibility/keyboard behavior on x64 and ARM development hosts before adopting upgrade.

deliberated_decisions.decision: Visual proof, color proof and encoded-output proof are distinct
deliberated_decisions.reason: Media team requires frame/time/proxy/color provenance; print documentation warns separation preview cannot cover all output conditions.
deliberated_decisions.rejected: Screenshot pass used as blanket colorimetry, print or media compatibility proof.
deliberated_decisions.proof: Real opened capture plus canonical metadata/scopes and independently decoded/exported artifact checks.

risks_and_blockers.evidence: HBR/Studio prose agent_label versus actual client_session_id wire.

risks_and_blockers.evidence: Operator InteractionBus uses one focus_owner/selection; existing leases are UI-resource keyed.

risks_and_blockers.evidence: Capture result has no document/render/frame/color identity; headless GPU path can return DEFERRED.

risks_and_blockers.mitigation: Revision-bound captures, causal terminal predicates, open exact pixels, and honest deferred capture state until real rendering is observed.

risks_and_blockers.evidence: Current snapshot cap is 4000 nodes; Studio exposes large catalogues, instances and property trees.
risks_and_blockers.impact: Visible/loaded rows mistaken for canonical set; bulk operation misses hidden items.
risks_and_blockers.mitigation: Explicit total/loaded/filtered/visible counts and pagination markers, backend canonical selectors, stable reveal by object ID and off-slice acceptance cases.

risks_and_blockers.evidence: STU-MAN-120/121 and shell OD items remain explicit active-spec decisions; prior source counts/prose coverage do not prove generated runtime contracts.
risks_and_blockers.impact: A mechanically generated name list can masquerade as capability parity or manual completeness.
risks_and_blockers.mitigation: Retain unresolved decisions and missing descriptions; promote executable behaviors/fixtures/workflows with exact acceptance. No full-parity claim from feature totals.

risks_and_blockers.evidence: Installed scripts/workspace resources inspected read-only; vendor GUI not opened. Native computer-use disabled; foreground launch forbidden by quiet rules.
risks_and_blockers.impact: Cannot assert exact current runtime panel geometry or behavior from resource files.
risks_and_blockers.mitigation: Keep source-derived statements separate. Obtain authorized non-intrusive runtime evidence or Operator-provided captured state before layout equivalence claims; no need to block this reference pass.

risks_and_blockers.evidence: New egui_tiles upstream includes identity/a11y fixes but different MSRV; current source pin remains 0.14.
risks_and_blockers.impact: Upgrade can break compiler/ARM development compatibility or stored layout IDs.

risks_and_blockers.evidence: Argus sees document visuals, while internal diagnostics/Palmistry have sensitive-data allowlists.
risks_and_blockers.impact: Document pixels/text sent into diagnostic ring or watcher output violate separate privacy boundary.
risks_and_blockers.mitigation: Keep authorized Argus artifacts/business receipts separate from internal telemetry; diagnostics emit IDs/status/resource counters allowed by their contracts, not project imagery/text.

installed_adobe_differential_gui_matrix.purpose: Extend the existing installed UI enrichment playbook with release-bound professional workflow comparisons. Current evidence is EXE metadata plus selected readable scripts/resources; proprietary implementation source and actual GUI have not been inspected. App install folder year is not a verified product version.
installed_adobe_differential_gui_matrix.execution_boundary: Native computer-use is disabled in this session and quiet-operation rules forbid foreground launch/focus theft. No vendor app is launched here. Runtime capture requires a subsequently available approved quiet path or a documented controlled Operator interaction step; unavailable GUI evidence remains NOT_INSPECTED. Do not stop or repurpose already-running apps/processes.
installed_adobe_differential_gui_matrix.artifact_root: Resolve the contract's external Handshake_Artifacts root, then a version/locale/fixture-specific folder; no repo target folder and no hardcoded installed path as product dependency. Preserve prior per-app original captures before new reconciliation; do not use merged normalized IDs with known collisions as canonical rows.
common_sequence: Freshly verify installed EXE release metadata and fixture/source digests; changes invalidate old release-bound evidence. Capture actual locale/workspace/DPI rather than infer from en_US resource path.
Inventory menu/toolbar/panel/control and keyboard paths in no-document, blank-document and opened-fixture contexts; capture stable IDs when obtainable and explicit absence when not.

For one declared workflow operation, capture vendor before state/pixels; perform exact operation; record resulting options, units, enabled states and real rendered outcome. Export and reopen using the selected profile/format.

Import the same source into implemented Studio asset harness or later mounted Studio; record conversion mapping/loss/unsupported findings, use typed domain command and corresponding Argus control path, and wait for causal render completion.

Open both exact outcome captures; compare declared semantic invariants and visual tolerances. Inspect reopened output independently. A feature row, parse success, pixel count or unchecked screenshot cannot mark workflow parity.

Repeat negative/context/scale cases: missing or revoked resource, stale revision, unavailable feature, cancellation/retry, hidden/off-slice item, narrow/high-DPI layout and keyboard/pen where applicable. Keep status NOT_RUN/NOT_INSPECTED/DEFERRED/PARTIAL/PROVEN with reasons rather than one suite-wide green flag.
